name: issue-tracker-mern
description: Issue Tracker System built with the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,user,admin -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd admin && npm install && npm run build
